description: This file defines the LocalCacheStore struct and its methods for managing various cache layers in the Mattermost server, including cache initialization, invalidation, and cluster message handling.

classes.name: LocalCacheStore
classes.description: Struct managing various cache layers for the Mattermost server, including initialization, invalidation, and cluster message handling.

methods.name: NewLocalCacheLayer
methods.description: Constructor function to initialize a LocalCacheStore with various cache layers, cluster message handlers, and configuration parameters.

methods.name: DropAllTables
methods.description: Invalidates all caches and drops all tables in the underlying store.

methods.name: doInvalidateCacheCluster
methods.description: Removes a cache entry and sends a cluster message to invalidate cache across nodes.

methods.name: doMultiInvalidateCacheCluster
methods.description: Removes multiple cache entries and sends cluster messages for each key.

methods.name: doStandardAddToCache
methods.description: Adds an item to cache with default expiry.

methods.name: doStandardReadCache
methods.description: Reads an item from cache, updating metrics and logging errors.

methods.name: doMultiReadCache
methods.description: Reads multiple items from cache, updating metrics.

methods.name: doClearCacheCluster
methods.description: Purges a cache and sends cluster message to invalidate cache.

methods.name: Invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates all cache layers managed by the store.
